Checklist Item: WCAG 2.1 AA compliance met

All focusable elements have :focus or :focus-visible styles with visible outline/box-shadow/border change; no outline:none or outline:0 without replacement focus style; focus ring provides >=2px visible boundary
Skip links implemented
Reduced motion respected
Announce dynamic content changes
Accessible buttons and links

Form validation errors use aria-invalid='true' on invalid fields; error messages linked via aria-describedby; error summary with anchor links present for forms with >3 fields; no alert() or browser-default-only validation as sole error mechanism
Accessible error messaging
ARIA labels provided where needed

Modal/dialog elements have role='dialog' or role='alertdialog' with aria-modal='true' and aria-labelledby/aria-label; keydown handler for Escape key present in source; focusable elements exist inside dialog container
Accessible tables
Accessible lists
Responsive and reflow-safe content
<video> elements have <track kind='captions'> with valid non-empty src
<audio> elements have adjacent transcript link or aria-describedby pointing to transcript content; transcript container visible (not display:none/visibility:hidden)
No focus-trap calls outside of modal/dialog components; no keydown handlers that programmatically restrict Tab key to a subset of elements on non-modal pages
Navigation depth within acceptable limit
No :hover-only JS event handlers (every click/mouseenter handler has a keyboard equivalent); every CSS :hover show/hide rule has a corresponding :focus or :focus-within rule on the same selector
Visible focus styles present
Animations respect prefers-reduced-motion
Total animation/transition count per page within threshold; no animations >2s duration; no infinite animations on non-loading elements
ARIA attributes used correctly
Sufficient contrast via tokens
No focus removed via CSS
All CSS :hover rules have corresponding :focus or :focus-visible rules on the same selectors
Visually-hidden patterns (.sr-only/.visually-hidden) use approved clip/position technique; no display:none or visibility:hidden on screen-reader-targeted text
Lighthouse accessibility score >= 90 in Chrome DevTools Lighthouse panel; zero critical (wcag2a/wcag2aa) accessibility violations reported; all flagged items reviewed and addressed or documented

Accessibility tree in Chrome DevTools Elements > Accessibility pane shows correct roles; names; and states for all interactive elements; no elements flagged with missing accessible name or invalid role; inspect via right-click element > Inspect > Accessibility tab

Color contrast ratio meets WCAG AA thresholds (4.5:1 for normal text; 3:1 for large text >= 18pt or 14pt bold); verify via Chrome DevTools Elements panel > Accessibility pane contrast ratio tooltip on text elements; or Lighthouse accessibility audit contrast section

Tab focus order traverses page content in logical reading sequence; no focus jumps to unexpected areas or gets lost; verify by tabbing through the page with Chrome DevTools Elements panel open tracking the highlighted active element in the DOM

Forced colors / high contrast mode renders page legibly; no content or UI controls disappear; verify via Chrome DevTools Rendering panel > Emulate CSS media feature forced-colors: active; all interactive elements remain visible

Page content reflows at 400% zoom without loss of information or functionality; no horizontal scrollbar required at 1280px width zoomed to 400% (equivalent to 320 CSS px viewport); verify via Chrome DevTools Device Toolbar set to 320px width (WCAG 1.4.10)
